summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Ponte chat MVP. 24/24 pytest cases passed against the public URL — auth (register/login/me + 409/401), user search by prefix (excludes self, @ prefix), conversations (create/idempotent/list/404/400-self), messages (translation pt<->es via OpenAI gpt-5.6-terra returning natural Rioplatense Spanish, ordered GET + mark-read, reply, react toggle, edit re-translates, delete soft-delete with 403 for non-owner), and media/voice endpoint auth guard. Frontend UI verified end-to-end on 390x844 viewport: Welcome → Login (bruno@test.com) → Chats list → FAB → Search '@luc' → open Lucia conversation → send text 'Testando integracao UI' → bubble renders with translated 'Probando integración de UI' as PRIMARY (larger) and original as smaller discrete text below (differentiator confirmed) → long-press opens actions sheet with reactions row (👍❤️😂😮😢🙏) + Responder/Editar/Apagar/Cancelar. Deleted-message and edited-badge rendering verified. No deprecated Expo packages (uses expo-audio). Two harmless RNW console warnings observed (pointerEvents & shadow* deprecations) — coming from RN core, not app code.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py test_reply_and_reactions toggle logic verified working; toggling same emoji removes it, different emoji replaces user's reaction (one reaction per user).

server.py:359 datetime.fromisoformat(last_read) parses ISO string persisted with iso() — works but comparing stored-as-string keys to datetime objects; consider storing last_read as datetime for consistency (minor, non-blocking).
GET /api/conversations/{id}/messages marks read side-effect on every GET — acceptable given polling every 2500ms; no bug.
Frontend AuthProvider signIn/signUp does router.replace inside the screen after awaiting, which combined with useProtectedRoute redirect could race; observed working correctly in tests.
RN Web console warnings (pointerEvents / shadow* deprecations) originate from RN internals and Ionicons — no action needed.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded users bruno@test.com and lucia@test.com. Test suite also creates one throwaway user per run (test_<uuid>@t.com) plus conversation messages between bruno and lucia. TEST_ prefix not used because API validates username regex — throwaway usernames use 'test_<uuid>' pattern instead.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public base URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://pt-es-chat.preview.emergentagent.com. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_ponte_api.py is idempotent (auto-registers bruno/lucia if missing) and finishes in ~10s. Voice endpoint /api/conversations/{id}/voice is only smoke-tested (auth-required) to avoid burning OpenAI credits — main agent can validate STT/TTS manually if needed. Long-press on web is simulated via mouse.down + wait 700ms + mouse.up (RN Pressable delayLongPress=250ms).
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA — this was an MVP verification run and all specified acceptance criteria pass.
